hero.title: Your trusted pet partner in Sri Lanka

intro.lead: At Catlitter.lk, we believe every pet deserves the best and every pet owner deserves a partner they can trust.
intro.body: Founded in Sri Lanka, Catlitter.lk has grown from a simple idea into one of the country's most recognised names in pet care. We offer a carefully curated range of pet food, accessories, grooming essentials, litter products, and more, all selected with your pet's health and happiness in mind.

brands.title: Three brands. One commitment.
brands.subtitle: Our family of stores gives you more ways to shop, wherever you are:

items.name: Catlitter.lk
items.description: Our flagship online platform, delivering quality pet essentials island-wide with ease and convenience.

items.name: Petlove
items.description: A warm, neighbourhood-friendly store bringing trusted pet care closer to your community.

items.name: Pet & Co.
items.description: A modern retail experience offering handpicked collections for the discerning pet owner.

philosophy.body: Whether you're raising a curious kitten, a loyal dog, or a playful parrot, our team is here to help you make the right choices. We combine product expertise with a genuine love for animals, because for us, this isn't just retail. It's a passion.

items.text: Island-wide delivery through our online store
Knowledgeable staff who care about your pet's wellbeing
Three convenient touchpoints, online and in-store

closing.body: We're proud to be part of Sri Lanka's growing pet care community, and we're committed to making pet parenting simpler, smarter, and more rewarding, one happy pet at a time.
